groups.note: 「石を投げた」を英語は「退けた」とする
食い違い: 韓国語は「新しい神学として喜んで受け入れた神学者の方が多かった」、英語は「一部が受け入れる用意があった」。「現実的な状況から生じた」を英語は「権力の問題」とする
diff: The Korean original says that among the theologians who studied the church from its early days, those who gladly accepted its teaching as an original and systematic new theology were the majority (English edition: “Some theologians … described our teachings as original and systematic. Some were prepared to accept them.”).
The Korean original says the heresy controversy grew out of practical circumstances rather than theological issues (English edition: “It had more to do with issues of power”).

groups.note: 投書した牧師らの中に金活蘭総長がいたことを英語は省く。E12 の「入会したとき」、E13 の「そこで知った」は英語の書き方
食い違い: 韓国語は「答えの出ない人生の疑問が、神の言葉を悟って（僕自身から）消えた」、英語 E29・E30 は「彼らの疑問に、僕の伝える神の言葉が答えた」と主語を変えている
diff: The Korean original says it was his own questions about life, which had tormented him for lack of answers, that vanished as if washed away once he grasped the word of God (English edition: “They had questions about life, and they could not find answers. The word of God I conveyed answered their questions with clarity.”).

groups.note: 「アダムとエバが犯した原罪」を英語は「人類の原罪」とする
diff: The Korean original says the original sin committed by Adam and Eve (English edition: “the original sin of humanity”).
